effective_capex.definition: Capital expenditure plus grants-in-aid for capital asset creation at the original Budget Estimate; no matching provisional value is assumed here.

research_notes: Fiscal-year snapshots must preserve announcement, estimate stage and source date.
CGA provisional accounts are unaudited and can change in final accounts.
Effective capex includes grants for creation of assets; comparing its BE directly to direct capex PA is invalid.
Loans disbursed are a component of capex but not proof assets were commissioned or utilised.
Cross-sectional public investment cannot identify private investment crowd-in without a counterfactual.
